title: Promotional Material Compliance Checker
short: Checks every claim in promotional material against the approved product information before it goes out.
symptom: Promotional materials stall in medical review
ingredient: A claim checker for marketing and medical teams
directions: Upload the leaflet or slide. Each claim is matched to the approved label and references, with unsupported claims highlighted.
problem: Marketing materials go through many review rounds because claims, indications and references must match the approved product information exactly.
why: Off-label or unsupported claims create legal, ethical and reputational risk; slow reviews delay launches.
solution: Extracts each claim, matches it to the approved label (SmPC) and cited references, and flags off-label, overstated or unsupported statements for the medical reviewer.
limitations: Rules differ by country and company code
Final approval stays with medical and regulatory reviewers
review: Medical and regulatory reviewers approve every material; the tool prepares the review.
